title: Why things can feel numb or empty (anhedonia)
content: One of the core features of depression is a reduced ability to feel pleasure, even from things that used to matter, sometimes called anhedonia. That's not the same as not caring; it's more like the emotional volume has been turned down on everything, which is also why some people describe it as numbness or emptiness rather than sadness.
